packageRules.description: PMS-1554: collapse every scheduled update into two PRs. Security advisories still open their own PR per advisory via `vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled` above; those bypass the group and are the third stream.
PMS-1554: the catch-all for minor, patch, pin and digest bumps across every manager.
Rust toolchain stays on its own: a toolchain bump has to land before any crate update that needs its new MSRV, so it cannot be folded into the general stream.
